window_width.description: Width of the window in pixels. Default is 360 for phone-sized windows.

window_height.description: Height of the window in pixels. Default is 640 for phone-sized windows.

tablet_mode.description: If true, starts in a tablet sized window (--tablet flag). If false, uses phone size (--phone flag or default).

workdir.description: The working directory to start the terminal in (--workdir flag).

force_auth.description: Force authentication on or off (--forceAuth flag).

import_paths.description: Additional QML import directories (-I flag). May be used multiple times.

shell.description: The shell command to execute. If empty, uses the default system shell.
